prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity 16:9 desktop documentation homepage design comp for an open-source Dart terminal UI framework
Input images: Image 1 is the first Noir Data-sublime homepage direction comp and establishes the product, black-and-white identity, lettering character, signal bars, and sine-lattice grammar. Image 2 is the visual-system quality board and sets the finish level. Preserve that complete visual world, but do not copy Image 1's composition.
Primary request: Create a safer documentation-first variation of the Noir Data-sublime homepage called Split Signal. It should express one useful idea at full scale: source and explanation on a white sheet, live terminal output on a black field, joined by the retained rendering signal.
Structure: A hairline top navigation with NOIR, 0.0.1-alpha.3, Start, Concepts, Guides, Widgets, API, GitHub. Below, divide the viewport at a hard vertical seam: the left 44% is a full-height black field containing a large crisp 80×24 terminal specimen, cell indices, and a restrained vertical bar stream. The right 56% is a white documentation sheet containing the exact headline, supporting line, architecture invariant, quick-start command, and actions. A single sine path crosses the seam and is labeled Widget, Element, RenderObject, Paint along its route. The next fold starts as a full-width four-row documentation index for Start, Build, Test, Extend, with alternating inversions and no cards.
Content: Exact headline "Reactive terminal UI, measured in cells." Supporting line "Noir brings Flutter-like widgets and retained state to Dart terminal apps." Command "$ dart pub add noir". Architecture line "Widgets declare. Elements preserve identity. RenderObjects layout and record paint." Actions "Get started" and "Read the guides". The terminal specimen should show a simple Noir counter and "Press Ctrl+C to exit."
Style/medium: Pure black and pure white only; no grey and no color. Pixel-crisp bar fields, hairline rules, tabular numerics, one seeded sine lattice. Use monospace for the headline, terminal, code, and measurements; a restrained proportional sans for explanation. Preserve high data density only at the outer edges and seam; keep the reading sheet calm.
Composition/framing: 2048×1152 landscape, full browser viewport, one strong split composition rather than a standard text-and-code hero or card grid. Show enough below the fold to prove the pattern can govern the site.
Interaction implied: SOURCE / FRAME / TREE changes which side owns more width and which pipeline label is inverted; the seam snaps to three exact positions. Reduced motion changes instantly without a sweep.
Constraints: Professional open-source documentation; clear prerelease status; no invented metrics, testimonials, benchmarks, or company logos; all visible text must be spelled correctly; use no more text than specified.
Avoid: generic SaaS hero, analytics dashboard, grey, color, green terminal cliché, neon, glow, gradients, glass, rounded cards, soft shadows, decorative icons, fake data, QR codes, device mockups, watermarks.
